subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: After narrowing the resolver input, should configured OpenAI-compatible memory embeddings preserve exact configured-hostname trust when policy is omitted, fail closed before probes when `allowPrivateNetwork` is explicitly false, and permit broader private-network access only when it is true?
rationale: This is an intentional SSRF trust and upgrade-compatibility contract; implementation correctness cannot authorize the behavior change for existing explicit-false configurations.

options.title: Approve three-state contract
options.body: Keep omitted exact-host compatibility, honor explicit false as a hard denial, and require explicit true for broader private-network access.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Block every private embedding endpoint unless `allowPrivateNetwork` is true, accepting a wider compatibility break for a simpler security rule.

options.title: Preserve exact-host access on false
options.body: Continue exact configured-hostname trust despite explicit false, avoiding the upgrade break but weakening denial semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve three-state contract
recommendation.body: Keep omitted exact-host compatibility, honor explicit false as a hard denial, and require explicit true for broader private-network access.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and expanded the canonical provider request-policy resolver whose permanent security contract is being applied to embeddings.
